name: mf-business-licence-and-patente-filing
description: French Saint-Martin business licence (droit de licence) and patente contribution for 2026 under the collectivity's tax code consolidated to 5 June 2026. Covers who is liable (habitual non-salaried professional activity), the article 1447-0A exemptions, the 300 euro fixed fee (150 euros for itinerant and market traders), the 5 euro per square metre area fee above 40 square metres with area rounded down and capped at 2,500 euros, the reference period, creation, cessation and operator changes, the new-enterprise patente abatements, and the annual declaration before 1 July with the patente balance by 30 November. Applies to French Saint-Martin. Trigger phrases include droit de licence Saint-Martin, patente Saint-Martin, DLCP, business licence Saint-Martin, licence fee per square metre.
